newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease, seen easing further.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease, seen easing further.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.21 percent on Thursday and traders predicted prices would slide further before the end of the year.
"Turnover and prices will probably go down by the end of the year," one trader said.
* The 10-share SBI index fell 2.53 points to 1,182.0.
* Drug maker Lek "A" issue was the most actively traded, falling 0.40 percent to 19,940 tolars on volume of 4,527 shares.
* Overall 11 shares fell, four rose, two remained unchanged and eight were untraded.
